mentions.name: Coconut Water Reviews
mentions.description: This website publishes coconut water reviews, with around 30 different brands reviewed so far. It grew out of the author's interest in coconut water terroir (e.g., unpasteurized young nam hom coconuts from central Thailand) and is a non-commercial hobby project that tracks a few dozen weekly readers via Google Analytics.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a website mostly to post  coconut water reviews. I never really liked coconut water until I tried an unpasteurized option and that led me to spiral down the rabbit hole of coconut water terroir.
